services_data.title: Collision Repair
services_data.description: Comprehensive structural realignment and body rebuilding after major or minor collisions, restored to OEM factory specifications.

services_data.title: Auto Body Repair
services_data.description: Full-spectrum metalwork, panel straightening, and seamless structural restoration for all makes and models.

services_data.title: Dent Repair
services_data.description: Advanced paintless dent repair (PDR) and conventional dent pulling to eliminate door dings, creases, and hail damage.

services_data.title: Bumper Repair
services_data.description: Plastic welding, crack repair, dent reshaping, and complete bumper replacement and color-matched refinishing.

services_data.title: Fender Repair
services_data.description: Restoration and realignment of bent or crushed fenders, quarter panels, and wheel wells with tight seam gaps.

services_data.title: Automotive Painting
services_data.description: Climate-controlled down-draft spray booth finishes with premium multi-stage polyurethane clear coats for a showroom mirror gloss.

services_data.title: Paint Matching
services_data.description: Computerized spectrophotometer digital color matching ensuring 100% invisible panel blending and exact factory tones.

services_data.title: Scratch Repair
services_data.description: Wet sanding, compound buffing, clear-coat blending, and deep key scratch elimination for flawless reflections.

services_data.title: Color Changes
services_data.description: Complete vehicle color conversions, custom metallic finishes, matte clear coats, and accent paint designs.

services_data.title: Insurance Claim Assistance
services_data.description: Hassle-free direct coordination with all major insurance carriers, itemized digital estimates, and supplement processing.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the single-page application with smooth scrolling anchor navigation linking Home, Services, About, Our Work, Reviews, Estimate, and Contact.
Follow the red and black aesthetic with obsidian background (#0B0D11), elevated carbon panels (#12161E), and vibrant crimson red (#DC2626) accents.
In `frontend/src/index.css`, import `@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk` for headings and `@fontsource-variable/dm-sans` for body copy.
Ensure all 10 requested services are rendered with distinct descriptions and category tags.
Implement the interactive Before/After comparison tool with interactive drag handle or slider.
Connect the Estimate Request form to a FastAPI endpoint `POST /api/estimates` in `backend/routers/estimates.py` (or `server.py`) and store submissions in MongoDB collection `estimates`.
Include simulated photo upload preview (allowing users to drop/select image files and see thumbnail previews).
Provide clear, professional placeholder tags for the Work Gallery and Reviews sections as requested.
Ensure the contact section displays the exact address: 6401 N Tryon St Suite B, Charlotte, NC 28213 and hours (Mon-Fri 9am-6pm, Sat 9am-4pm, Sun closed).
Implement mobile-first responsiveness with a fixed quick-call bar on small viewports.
Add `data-testid` to all interactive buttons, inputs, links, and key cards as defined in data_testid_manifest.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic SaaS blue or default template spacing. Use high-contrast carbon and crimson.
Never use AI robot emojis for icons; use Lucide-react icons exclusively.
Use generous padding (py-20 to py-28 for main sections) to prevent cramped automotive layouts.
All form fields must use custom styled input/select components with visible focus rings in crimson.
Use Sonner for toast confirmations on estimate submissions and action buttons.
